description: Canva connector (read-only). Surfaces the authenticated user's designs as canva:design items in the local index via GET /rest/v1/designs — the design title, the create timestamp, the last-modified timestamp, the edit url, the view url, and the thumbnail url. Bearer OAuth auth (Authorization: Bearer <token>; short-lived access token refreshed by the Gateway via the 3-legged OAuth authorization-code flow with PKCE; never logged); fixed SaaS host api.canva.com. The list endpoint paginates by the response continuation query param until absent; the gateway-side syncable walks a single forward pass per cycle, page-capped. Read-only — hitlRequired is intentionally empty. Sparse structured design metadata; the canonical url is the design view url.
author: Nimbus
